name: The Pebble of Kajaro
label: Quest
description: The Pebble of Kajaro: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Welcome back, adventurer. I can see that the pebble has seen much use. Many of our foes have fallen to your otherworldly abilities. Their suffering has been great. It is time that I enhance the power of the pebble. Give it to me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Be unstoppable, like the molten fronts of Kajaro.
